name: Modern Web Guidance
summary: A set of skills from the Chrome, Edge, Firefox and MDN teams and community that steers coding agents toward built-in web platform features instead of legacy JavaScript, with guides, browser-compatibility data and a legacy-code scanner.
install_steps: Run npx modern-web-guidance@latest install and follow the wizard
Or use another route from the README, such as npx skills add GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance
For Claude Code, run /plugin marketplace add GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance, then /plugin install modern-web-guidance@googlechrome
To try it first, run npx modern-web-guidance@latest search followed by a short description of what you want to build
example_use_case: Asking your coding agent to add a modal dialog and having it use the browser's native dialog support instead of custom scripts.
